helpModal.title: Guide & Help
helpModal.subtitle: Your tour of eStundnzettl

intro.body: No more paper slips! With eStundnzettl you log your work hours, drives, vacation and more straight from your phone. At the end of the month a single tap produces a clean PDF.

step1.title: Log hours
step1.lead: You have two ways to log your hours:
step1.timerBody: Long-press the <plus>+</plus> button in the bottom right and swipe up. The timer runs until you stop it with a tap. The app then fills in start, end and duration automatically.
step1.manualBody: Tap the + button. Pick start and end time, break and project. With "Same as last" you copy the times from yesterday — handy when your hours stay the same!

step2.title: Drive times
step2.lead: When creating an entry, pick the type "Drive" at the top.
step2.arrival: Arrival/Departure: Paid working time — counts towards the daily target.

step3.title: Vacation, sick & time off
step3.body: Just pick Vacation, Sick or TO (time off). The app automatically credits the right target hours for that day. You can also enter times manually if needed.

step4.title: Attach documents
step4.body: You can attach photos or files to any entry — e.g. delivery notes, receipts or work reports. Tap "Documents" on the entry. Attachments are bundled automatically when you export the PDF.

step5.title: Month close & PDF
step5.preview: Tap the <icon/> icon in the top right. There you see a preview of your timesheet — filterable by month or week.
step5.share: Check it, then share as PDF — via email, WhatsApp or just save it locally. Done!

step6.title: Backup & data safety
step6.lead: Your data is precious — back it up!
step6.gdriveBody: Connect your Google account in settings. The app will back up to the cloud every day automatically.
step6.localBody: Pick a folder on your device. The app backs up there every day — completely offline.

step7.title: Power-user mode
step7.lead: For pros who want more! Enable Power-user mode at the very bottom of settings. Extra features then become visible:
step7.codes: Activity codes — industry presets or your own codes

tips.title: Tips & tricks
tips.deleteBody: Swipe an entry to the left to delete it.
tips.autoBackupBody: Once connected, the app backs up daily, automatically.
tips.themeBody: Light, dark or System — pick your favorite in settings.

helpModal.tagline: "So not a single hour gets lost!"

welcome.title: Quick tour?
welcome.body: Hello! Let's walk through a few quick steps to show you where things live. You can tap the X and skip at any time.

dashboard.title: Your overview
dashboard.body: Here you see at a glance: actual hours, target hours and your overtime for the selected month. Tap a week to expand or collapse it.

fabTap.title: Manual entry
fabTap.body: The green button in the bottom right is your main tool. A short tap opens the new-entry form right away — perfect for filling things in later.

fabTimer.title: Start the live timer
fabTimer.body: The same button also starts the live timer: press and hold until it turns green, then swipe up. Tap again to stop the timer and the entry is created automatically.

report.title: Timesheet as PDF
report.body: The green button in the top right: your finished timesheet, ready to view, share or print. With signature, notes and your logo.

settings.title: Settings & more
settings.body: The gear icon is your control center: profile, work schedule, activity codes, backup, theme and help. Everything can be changed at any time.

done.title: That's it!
done.body: You now know all the important spots. If you want to read up on something later: Settings → Help. Have fun with eStundnzettl!
